NACHRICHTEN.BESCHREIBUNG: Where and when the bot announces a level-up, and with which message
NACHRICHTEN.MODUS_KANAL_DER_NACHRICHT: In the channel where the XP was earned
NACHRICHTEN.MODUS_HINWEIS: “Channel where the XP was earned” means the voice channel's chat for voice XP and the command's channel for /xp.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAL_HINWEIS: With “channel where the XP was earned” it is the fallback when the XP have no channel.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAELE_FEHLEN: The bot did not answer, so the channel list is missing.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAL_FEHLT: No level channel is selected. Until then there is no level-up message.
NACHRICHTEN.MEILENSTEINE_HINWEIS: Levels separated by commas, for example 5, 10, 25. Jumping past a milestone counts too.
NACHRICHTEN.RANGKARTE: Attach the rank card as an image
NACHRICHTEN.RANGKARTE_HINWEIS: The same card as /rank. Set its look under Image cards.
NACHRICHTEN.GESPEICHERT: Saved. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
NACHRICHTEN.NICHT_EINGERICHTET: Leveling is not set up here yet.
NACHRICHTEN.FALSCHER_KANAL: This channel does not exist on the server.
NACHRICHTEN.MEILENSTEINE_FEHLEN: “Only at milestones” needs at least one level from 1 to 1000.
NACHRICHTEN.FEHLER: Saving failed. The reason is in the dashboard log.
NACHRICHTEN.MELDUNG_TEXT: Level-up messages go to the level channel, and none is selected here. Until then the bot announces no level-up.

XP_REGELN.BESCHREIBUNG: How much XP there is for what, and how often. All values are free; the starting values are only a suggestion.
XP_REGELN.HINWEIS_NACHRICHT: Each message gives a random amount from…to. Within the cooldown only the first message per member counts; 0 means every message counts.
XP_REGELN.HINWEIS_SPRACHE: Each interval (at least 60 s) gives a random amount from…to to everyone listening.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_CHAT: On average {{mittel}} XP per message, at most one every {{takt}} s: up to {{stunde}} XP per hour of writing.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_CHAT_OHNE_TAKT: On average {{mittel}} XP per message, no cooldown: every message counts.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_SPRACHE: On average {{mittel}} XP per interval, that is {{minute}} XP per minute or {{stunde}} XP per hour.
XP_REGELN.MINDESTLAENGE_HINWEIS: Shorter messages do not count. Emoji count as one character; 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.GLEICHE_FENSTER_S_HINWEIS: If someone writes the same text again within this time, it does not count. 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.STORNO_LOESCHEN_MIN_HINWEIS: If a message is deleted within this time, its XP is taken back. 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.STORNO_AUTOMOD: Take XP back when automod flags the message
XP_REGELN.STORNO_AUTOMOD_HINWEIS: Only works if automod is on in this guild.
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_MIN_MENSCHEN: Minimum listening people in the channel
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_MIN_MENSCHEN_HINWEIS: Bots and deafened members do not count. With 1 you also get XP alone.
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_STUMM_HINWEIS: Deafened members never get XP, and there is none in the AFK channel.

STUFEN.BESCHREIBUNG: From how much XP each level applies. Below you see roughly how long that takes.
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_TITEL: Check: what does this mean for members?
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_TEXT: Per level: how many counted messages or how much time in voice it takes, based on the current XP rules.
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_HINWEIS: Multipliers and exclusions are not included. Change the rates under
STUFEN.RATE_CHAT: Chat: on average {{xp}} XP per message, at most one every {{sekunden}} s.
STUFEN.RATE_SPRACHE: Voice: on average {{xp}} XP per minute.
STUFEN.NAME: Name

BELOHNUNGEN.BESCHREIBUNG: Roles that members get, or give back, from a level on.
BELOHNUNGEN.ROLLEN_FEHLEN: The bot is not answering right now. Role names are missing, and new roles are only checked for their form.
BELOHNUNGEN.KEINE_STUFEN: There are no levels yet. Create them under “Levels”.
BELOHNUNGEN.ART_ROLLE_GEBEN_HINWEIS: From this level on the member gets the role. If they drop below (e.g. because XP was reversed), it goes again.
BELOHNUNGEN.ART_ROLLE_NEHMEN_HINWEIS: From this level on Leveling takes back a level role it gave itself. Roles someone gave by hand stay.
BELOHNUNGEN.VORHERIGE: Keep only the roles of the highest level
BELOHNUNGEN.VORHERIGE_HINWEIS: On: with a new reward role, the level roles of lower levels go. Off: they stack.
BELOHNUNGEN.SYNC_HINWEIS: Changes apply at a member’s next level change. For everyone right away: /levels sync in Discord.

AUSSCHLUESSE.BESCHREIBUNG: Where and for whom there is no XP, XP only in certain channels, or more and less.
AUSSCHLUESSE.BOT_FEHLT: The bot is not answering right now. Names and the per-channel count are missing.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ZAEHLUNG_HINWEIS: Counted by the channel rules. Role rules act per member and are not included here.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_AUSSCHLIESSEN_HINWEIS: No XP here or with this role. Comes before all other rules; for channels also covers threads.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_NUR_HINWEIS: Once such a rule exists, there is XP only there (channels and roles separately): with “only here” for a category, all other channels stop counting.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_FAKTOR_HINWEIS: More or less XP, e.g. 2 = double, 0.5 = half. For channels the most specific rule applies (channel before category), for roles the highest multiplier; both are multiplied.
AUSSCHLUESSE.LEER_TEXT: XP everywhere, the same for everyone.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ANGELEGT: Rule added. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ENTFERNT: Rule removed. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
AUSSCHLUESSE.REIHENFOLGE: Order in the bot: “no XP” first, then “only here”, then multipliers.
